artifact.notes: Round-1 before/after proof, run live 2026-08-24 against the plan coffee-pilot-round1 declared 2026-08-07. Same yardstick as the baseline by construction: handoff_minutes under the T-11 operational definition and the T-12-passed measurement system, one copy each. Before is the frozen baseline dataset (wait-times.csv, n=120, engine sha 6d31a43fbf305e84fad004cb20d0d06b02a395c3a59f9e6ba89aaf2ba1c72dc0); after is the full declared pilot window (after-round1.csv, n=120, all 10 mornings, no trimming). charter_baseline_value is the measured baseline mean 8.408333 -- the number the charter's 8.4 reconciled to without revision (measure/baseline-statement.md) -- so the gap arithmetic runs on computed values end to end. Confounders re-answered against what actually happened; guardrails are the charter's two consequential metrics, counted over the same windows (remake rate from the barista waste sheet, labor hours from the time clock -- scheduled 8.0 h for the two-barista morning shift plus peak-end overtime, the COPQ's overtime basis). Every computed number below (stability, capability, Welch t, gap, verdict) is the engine's; the run is recorded in improve-run.md.

plain_language.comparison_summary: Compared before (n=120, mean=8.408) against after (n=120, mean=6.198) using Welch's two-sample t-test (unequal variances assumed by default -- no equal-variance check to trip on).
plain_language.effect_size_in_words: Cohen's d = 2.31 -- a large difference (Cohen 1988 conventional bands: negligible<0.2, small<0.5, medium<0.8, large>=0.8).
plain_language.p_value_meaning: p = 0.0000, below the alpha=0.05 threshold: if there were truly no difference, a result at least this far from 'no difference' would turn up by chance alone only about 2.2e-43% of the time. That makes the difference statistically detectable here -- it does not mean the null hypothesis is false with that probability, and it says nothing yet about whether the difference is big enough to matter.
plain_language.practical_significance_prompt: Statistically detectable ≠ big enough to matter -- compare the effect size above against the goal.
